latestVersion.changelog:
core-brainstorming 0.1.0

- Initial release introducing a structured, dialogue-driven brainstorming workflow.
- Guides users from clarifying ideas to stepwise design presentation and validation.
- Emphasizes asking one focused question at a time, preferring multiple choice format.
- Includes extension hooks for embedded and simulation projects.
- Outlines documentation and handoff to implementation planning.
